name: Note from Jenny
source:
A short visual novel about schoolgirl cats.

During Norma's test, she receives a note from a friend named Jenny. It's in your hands to develop this story!

[From [url=https://methynecros.itch.io/note-from-jenny]itch.io[/url]]
